At roughly what angle should a sparkling bottle be held when opening?
Never point the bottle at anyone.
Sweetness in food makes wine seem…?
A. More acidic, bitter and astringent
The wine should be at least as sweet as the food.
What is rhum agricole made from?
Martinique has had an AOC since 1996.
What is the polishing threshold for honjozo?
Short answer: a guest says their wine smells of “wet cardboard”. Describe your judgement and the steps you take.
Do not argue; apologise and replace with a fresh bottle of the same wine
If none remains, offer an alternative of similar price and style
Record and report it, and return it to the supplier

A wet-cardboard smell is most likely TCA cork taint. Check it yourself by smell, but do not argue with the guest; apologise and replace it with a fresh bottle of the same wine, or if none remains, offer an alternative of similar price and style. Finally, record it, inform the manager and return the faulty bottle to the supplier.
Short answer: compare tequila and mezcal in raw material, origin and style.
Tequila: Jalisco and parts of four other states
Mezcal: many agaves, Espadín most common, mainly Oaxaca
Tequila has age grades such as Blanco, Reposado, Añejo and Extra Añejo

Tequila may use only Blue Weber agave, from Jalisco and parts of four other states; its style is cleaner, and it is graded by age as Blanco, Reposado, Añejo and Extra Añejo. Mezcal can use many agaves (Espadín most common), mainly from Oaxaca, and traditionally roasts the agave hearts in earthen pits with wood and stones, giving a distinct smokiness.
